SPINDEL

180minutes
36solder joints
difficulty

A floating hydrometer that reports from inside the fermenter

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

12SPINDEL-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    CELL_PLUSGNDBAT_PROTECTEDGNDVBAT_SWITCHEDGND3V3GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    CELL_PLUSBattery + · Charger B+
    CELL_MINUSBattery - · Charger B-
    BAT_PROTECTEDCharger OUT+ · Power switch COM
    VBAT_SWITCHEDPower switch A · Controller 5V · Tilt sensor VCC · Battery sense 1
    GNDCharger OUT- · Controller G · Tilt sensor GND · Thermometer GND
    I2C_SDAController D3 · Tilt sensor SDA
    I2C_SCLController D4 · Tilt sensor SCL
    3V3Controller 3V3 · Thermometer VDD · Data pull-up 1
    ONEWIREData pull-up 2 · Thermometer DQ · Controller D6
    BATTERYBattery sense 2 · Controller A0
    WAKEController D0 · Wake link 1
    RESETWake link 2 · Controller RST
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
13SPINDEL-WIRE-1

Spindel is built

Spindel is a hand-wired build of the open-source iSpindel: a sealed tube that floats in fermenting wort and tilts less as sugar turns to alcohol. Every 15 minutes it wakes, reads its tilt and the temperature, sends both over Wi-Fi to a logging service and goes back to sleep, so a brewer can follow gravity without opening the vessel.
